veranderings.rede: 'Gemeng' on its own reads oddly as a predicate for a place; the noun phrase is more natural and matches the list heading and glossary term the learner meets next.

veranderings.voor: net so deel van ons erfenis
veranderings.na: net so goed deel van ons erfenis
veranderings.rede: 'Net so deel van' is clipped; 'net so goed deel van' is the idiomatic Afrikaans form, with the same meaning.
